sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate now faithfully preserves the ship-to-firefighter-outfit path, constrains each outfit as an equipmentItem so hasStorageLocation is checked on its required owner, requires a physical storage location and a storageTemperatureClass, and enforces the warmStorageLocation controlled value. No vocabulary, datatype, unit, target, applicability, or dependency-contract issues remain.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the owner/path structure: hasStorageLocation has requiredOwner equipmentItem, but the candidate constrains it directly on a firefighterOutfitItem node; check it on the supplied canonical equipmentItem owner without inventing or duplicating ship/component links.
